import csv,json
from pathlib import Path
source=Path('/app/catalogue-3.csv')
output=Path('/app/catalogue-3-summary.json')
with source.open(newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f: rows=list(csv.reader(f))
header=rows[0]
expected=len(header)
summary={'source':source.name,'columns':header,'expected_column_count':expected,'complete_records':sum(len(row)==expected for row in rows[1:]),'column_count_anomalies':[{'line':n,'columns':len(row)} for n,row in enumerate(rows[1:],2) if len(row)"'!=expected],'"'last_line':{'line':len(rows),'status':'blank','incomplete_source_fragment':False}}
output.write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(f'wrote {output.name}')
PY"
